info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Gardening Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Gardening Produce Detail Management API enables users to efficiently create and manage detailed information about gardening produce. This API supports the addition of new produce items to the catalog, ensuring that all necessary attributes and specifications are recorded. Typically used by gardening supply retailers and e-commerce platforms, it facilitates a streamlined approach to inventory management and product listings. Developers can integrate this API to enhance their cataloging systems and improve the user experience for end customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information about their gardening produce. It facilitates the addition of new records, enabling better tracking and management of produce data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide details about the gardening produce. It allows the user to submit various attributes and characteristics related to their gardening efforts. Properly structured JSON data must be provided to ensure successful processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the gardening produce.

CreateCatalogGardeningProduceDetailReque.title: Gardening Produce Request Body

gardening_produce_id.description: Unique identifier for the gardening produce.

requestedBy.description: Name or identifier of the individual requesting the gardening produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of gardening produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the gardening produce.
